question: Quelle est la facture ayant le montant TTC le plus élevé, et quel est son fournisseur ?
sql_raw_extracted:
SELECT 
    fi.invoice_id AS facture_id,
    fi.supplier_id AS fournisseur_id,
    fi.net_amount,
    fi.vat_rate,
    fi.tot_amount,
    s.supplier_name,
    d.date
FROM 
    fact_invoice fi
JOIN 
    dim_date d ON fi.invoice_date_id = d.date_id
JOIN 
    dim_supplier s ON fi.supplier_id = s.supplier_id
JOIN 
    dim_vat v ON fi.vat_rate = v.vat_rate
WHERE 
    fi.tot_amount = (
        SELECT MAX(tot_amount) 
        FROM fact_invoice
    )
ORDER BY 
    fi.tot_amount DESC
LIMIT 1;
